notes: HSA plans (3500 HSA, 5000 HSA): no SBC is on file, so their values come from the one-page rate sheet only; everything the rate sheet does not list is marked as not listed.
Where the rate sheet and an SBC disagree, the SBC is used — the rate sheet itself says the Schedule of Benefits / plan documents govern.
Self-insured group plan. Cigna is the network, not the insurance company.
Medically underwritten — approval is not guaranteed and final rates can land above or below the quoted rate.
Applicant must be self-employed with their own EIN (per the USA Health product page summarized in TRIAD-Cigna-PPO.md).
Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum run on the calendar year (January 1 – December 31).
Failure to obtain precertification reduces the benefit by 50%, up to a $2,500 maximum penalty.

Not covered: acupuncture, bariatric surgery, cosmetic surgery, adult dental care, adult hearing aids, infertility treatments, long-term care, non-emergency care when traveling outside the U.S., private-duty nursing, routine foot care, weight loss programs.
Other covered services (limits may apply): chiropractic care, durable medical equipment, hearing aids (under age 18), routine eye care (adult).
Cigna PPO provider search: select "Employer or School", continue as guest, then choose "PPO, Choice Fund PPO".
